tasks.analysis: Modern biochemistry focuses on the chemical processes within and related to living organisms.It is a laboratory-based science that combines biology and chemistry.Biochemists investigate how cells function and communicate, exploring the fundamental mechanisms that sustain life.The field has advanced our understanding of how diseases occur and how they can be treated or prevented.Techniques such as molecular cloning and protein analysis are central to biochemistry, leading to innovations in medicine and biotechnology. 现代生物化学关注的是生命体内部及与生命相关的化学反应过程。它是一门基于实验室的科学，结合了生物学与化学。生物化学家研究细胞如何运作与交流，探索维持生命的基本机制。这一领域加深了我们对疾病如何发生、以及如何治疗和预防疾病的理解。分子克隆、蛋白质分析等技术是生物化学的核心，推动了医学与生物技术的创新。
